Package io.webagent4j.browsercrawler

Class BrowserCrawler

java.lang.Object
io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.BrowserCrawler
All Implemented Interfaces:
IBrowserCrawler
public final class BrowserCrawler extends Object implements IBrowserCrawler
The deterministic, single-lane browser crawler engine - the only implementation of IBrowserCrawler, mirroring how HttpCrawler is the only implementation of ICrawler.

Each crawl(BrowserCrawlRequest) call constructs a private, per-call Session holding all mutable state, so one BrowserCrawler instance is stateless and safe to reuse across calls - the same pattern HttpCrawler uses. See docs/browser-crawler.md for the full navigation/stability/failure pipeline and why this engine deliberately does not attempt physical navigation concurrency: IBrowser and IPage are both documented as not thread-safe, and one caller-supplied IBrowser is the crawl session (cookies/storage/auth all live on it) - so every backend call this engine makes happens on the single thread that calls crawl(io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.BrowserCrawlRequest), never offloaded to a worker pool.

    • crawl

      public BrowserCrawlResult crawl(BrowserCrawlRequest request)
      Description copied from interface: IBrowserCrawler
      Runs one crawl to completion and returns its result.

      Blocks the calling thread until the crawl reaches a BrowserCrawlTerminationReason. Does not close request's browser unless the request explicitly opts into it - see docs/browser-crawler.md#resource-ownership.
